{{Top|leg}}
'''Darg-3''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point, marked by a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|navigation buoy]], in deep space. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class prison ship]] ''[[Dargon]]'' was attempting to reach this jump point when it was [[Rescue from the Dargon|attacked]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces making a bid to disable and capture the vessel. The ''Dargon'' is believed to have eventually reached Darg-3, although whether it was under Rebel or Imperial control at the time is uncertain.
